messages:
maria: Quick FYI — onboarding sample app logs are leaking user email in debug logs when auth fails. Repro on Node SDK v0.9.2. Local dev run shows plaintext email in error lines.

sam: ugh, that's bad. can you paste the log lines?

maria: here's the redacted snippet I grabbed (dev):
[ERROR] auth: failed to exchange token request_id=abc123 user_email=jane.doe@example.com stack=AuthError

sam: looks like our redaction filter isn't applied to error logs emitted by the retry middleware. node uses `loglevel` and we only wrap request/response logging, not errors thrown in middleware.

alex: @sam is this parity with python/go? we need a consistent default redaction policy across SDKs.

lee: quick note: OpenTelemetry spans are getting request_id for normal HTTP routes but not for websocket/streaming paths in the sample app. streaming path flows skip the trace hook.

sam: repro'ed. node sdk doesn't call `tracer.setAttribute` on stream events. i'll add a small hook to attach the rw.request_id attr on stream start/end.

maria: ideal fix list: (1) redact emails/ssns by default in all logs + errors, (2) ensure request_id is attached to every log/span, (3) expose a simple config hook for custom redaction rules so customers can add patterns.

alex: proposed config example (for sample app README):
```json
{
  "telemetry": {
    "redact_patterns": ["email", "ssn", "credit_card"],
    "request_id_header": "x-rw-request-id",
    "otel": { "enabled": true, "propagate_by_default": true }
  }
}
```

lee: +1. For Otel attributes prefer the semantic key `rw.request_id` to avoid clashing with other libs. map `x-rw-request-id` header -> attribute. Also we should log at INFO by default in sample app, DEBUG only when `RW_DEBUG=true`.

sam: i'll open a PR for node sdk + sample app. plan: add middleware wrapper to redaction util, patch retry middleware to call sanitizers, and add otel span attribute on streaming handlers. will include unit + e2e with toggled logging levels.

maria: please also add a small integration test that asserts no email-like regex appears in logs at ERROR level for failed auth flows. cc @alex for test design. :lock:

telemetry-bot: created issue #4827 for node/sdk redaction + otel propagation (assigned to sam)

sam: thx bot. target: patch release next week. anyone available to review the PR this afternoon?

alex: I can give a quick review after standup. :thumbsup:

maria: awesome — moving to verify in dev stack once merged.
